title: East Ramapo pilot digital operating plan
status: Proposed requirements and implementation plan; no software, accounts, integrations or production controls established by this research
recommendation: Configure one secure operations workspace and established business services for one in-person SLP plus a separately qualified backup. Use the district-approved clinical and invoicing processes. Custom software is not required to prepare the bid, and an ATS, district portal or native mobile app is not justified for the initial one-to-three-clinician scope.

scope.proposed_pilot: One named in-person SLP, one qualified backup and one buyer; expand to no more than three active clinicians only after buyer-authorized assignments, staffing capacity and economics are confirmed.
scope.record_boundary: The district-designated system remains authoritative for IEPs, student-session logs and clinical records. The agency workspace holds staffing, readiness, contract, work-time and financial references, with only district-approved minimum student-related metadata. Opaque student IDs and attendance references can still be protected data.
scope.human_accountability: Named credential, clinical, employer/payroll, commercial and district owners remain responsible for decisions. One operator may hold several administrative roles, but clinical credentials cannot be replaced by an AI agent and financial release should have an independent human review.
not_in_scope: Autonomous therapy, diagnosis, IEP decisions or clinical signatures
Teletherapy: the reviewed addendum requires in-person delivery
Student-facing AI, recording sessions or uploading clinical material to general-purpose AI tools
A new district EHR/IEP system, Medicaid claims engine or copied Amergis database
A custom ATS, native mobile app, multi-district marketplace or automated background-check adjudication
Production integrations without permission, a selected product edition and tested field-level access

evidence_boundary: East Ramapo procurement obligations below come from the reviewed RFP/addendum. Product names, states, internal reminder dates, effort ranges and acceptance tests are our proposed design. Generic vendor APIs researched in earlier phases are not evidence that East Ramapo uses them or that this operator has integration permission.

external_source_refs.supports: East Ramapo has a district data-protection-agreement/vendor-security process and Policy 8635. A vendor listing does not grant access or approve a particular AI use.
NY Education Law 2-d provides additional contractor data-security/privacy obligations for covered records; applicable data-plan, training, permitted-use and subprocessor terms need district review.
NYSED does not certify vendors as compliant; the district must determine compliance. A vendor's marketing claim is not a clearance.

sources.title: East Ramapo RFP-ER-5-27
sources.provenance: work/amergis-phase6/challengers.json CHS04; Phase 7 bid research rechecked page-specific clauses

sources.limits: The 30-day clause is an invoice-submission deadline, not a payment promise. Exact fee units, designated software and API access are not established. Final addenda and executed agreement govern.

sources.supports: In-person services; proposed individual clinicians' resumes and references at bid; later clinician additions possible; assignments may range from individual part-time sessions to full-time leave coverage.
sources.limits: No guaranteed hours, assignment count or acceptance of a particular clinician.

sources.supports: Proposed shared operating core, single record ownership, established payroll/accounting and credential services, approval and audit boundaries.
sources.evidence_type: Earlier independent design, not observed East Ramapo software

operating_stack.internal_experience: One configured operations workspace with eight linked views: bid/contract, clinicians, readiness, assignments, service-completion references, time, invoices and exceptions. Views may be existing secure tables/forms; they are not eight separate products.
operating_stack.therapist_experience: Existing secure document-upload link, approved calendar and timekeeping/payroll application, plus the district's clinical system. A thin mobile web page is optional after repeated workflow friction is demonstrated.
operating_stack.district_experience: BidNet for the proposal and the district's approved access, assignment, time/attendance and invoice channels. No custom district account or portal is required initially.
operating_stack.foundation: Operator-controlled domain, professional email, MFA, scoped accounts, secure document storage, approved electronic signature, password/secrets management, backups and a named access administrator.
operating_stack.record_ownership_rule: Select one authoritative record per category. A status/reference in the operations workspace must not become a second editable payroll, accounting or clinical master.
operating_stack.integration_default: Manual, permissioned handoffs with an external receipt/reference. Configure automatic synchronization only after a real need, documented permission and a tested interface are established.
operating_stack.cost_position: No vendor selected and no software quote obtained. Subscription, implementation, integration and AI usage costs remain quote-required inputs to the pilot model. Effort ranges below are planning estimates, not pricing or a committed delivery schedule.

capabilities.name: Clinician intake and evidence vault
capabilities.purpose: Assemble each proposed clinician's complete, consented evidence packet and availability without placing employment or identity documents in general email threads.
minimum_records: Provider ID, contact and consent scope
minimum_states_actions: DRAFT -> EVIDENCE_REQUESTED -> REVIEW_PENDING -> PACKET_APPROVED
Worker corrects or withdraws a submission
Owner exports only the approved packet version
capabilities.record_authority: Agency clinician/evidence workspace; authoritative credential issuers remain external. Payroll identity/bank/tax details belong in the selected HR/payroll service, not this general roster.
capabilities.integration_status: No selected intake platform, vendor API or automatic credential feed. Secure upload and reviewed document export are the initial route.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Recruiting can request evidence; credential reviewer sees restricted qualifications; commercial signer approves the named proposal packet. AI cannot certify authenticity or select/reject a clinician autonomously.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Consent and role-limited access; approved personnel/credential retention schedule and holds. No student data. Reference contact details do not authorize unsolicited automated outreach.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Restricted folders plus a versioned checklist and human-reviewed PDF packet.
capabilities.acceptance: An expired, mismatched or missing required credential remains visibly incomplete; an unapproved document or changed resume cannot silently enter the frozen proposal packet.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure existing secure forms/folders and roster for two proposed clinicians; excludes clinician sourcing, verification wait time and vendor onboarding.

capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Confirm which clinician evidence must accompany the proposal versus appointment/start; use the actual bid requirements.

capabilities.name: Credential, insurance and exclusion-check register
capabilities.purpose: Show who is cleared for which assignment and which company coverage or recurring checks are due, with authoritative evidence and a named reviewer.
minimum_records: Monthly SAM, OIG and NY OMIG check evidence
Reviewer, source URL/reference, checked date, next due date and result
minimum_states_actions: INCOMPLETE -> REVIEW_PENDING -> READY or BLOCKED
Evidence change -> INVALIDATED until reviewed
Create recurring exclusion-check task; record human-verified result
Flag potential match and route for review; prepare district notice for authorized sending
capabilities.record_authority: Issuers, screening/clearance authorities and insurers establish underlying facts; agency owns a dated readiness decision. District acceptance is separate from agency review.
capabilities.integration_status: Manual official-source checks initially. No bulk lookup/API entitlement or continuous-monitoring service verified. A scanned card, OCR extraction or successful search request is not verification.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Qualified credential lead approves readiness; licensed clinical lead assesses clinical suitability; authorized HR owner handles adverse information; broker/insurer confirms coverage. Agent cannot resolve a potential exclusion match or waive a missing requirement.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Screening and medical information are restricted separately from general staffing status. Store only necessary evidence and approved result references, with personnel/screening-specific retention and access.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Dated official-source checks, restricted evidence folder, recurring calendar and signed readiness checklist.
capabilities.acceptance: A clinician with license evidence but missing required school clearance cannot become READY. Monthly checks create evidence for every covered worker/subcontractor; a possible match escalates immediately. A confirmed exclusion/status notice is tracked to the RFP's three-day deadline, without treating a future scheduled check as evidence the check occurred.

effort_estimate.basis: Register/rules/checklists configuration; excludes credential review labor, district response time, screening charges and insurance underwriting.

capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Resolve required versus sample insurance clauses and exact school clearance route; confirm calendar/deadline interpretation and district notice recipient before operation.

capabilities.name: Bid, contract and authorized-order room
capabilities.purpose: Prepare a complete controlled proposal, preserve submission evidence and later distinguish an awarded contract from an authorized assignment.
minimum_records: Source document, clause/page, requirement and owner
Proposed fee units, prices, exclusions and assumptions
Signature approval and exact submitted version
Award, executed terms and each district-authorized order
minimum_states_actions: DRAFT -> REVIEW_PENDING -> APPROVED -> SUBMITTED with receipt
Material change invalidates approval
AWARD_RECEIVED does not create an assignment
CONTRACT_EXECUTED + AUTHORIZED_ORDER permits staffing preparation, subject to readiness
capabilities.record_authority: Signed contract, final governing addenda, authorized district orders and BidNet acknowledgment; agency owns the indexed evidence and controlled working drafts.
capabilities.integration_status: Electronic BidNet submission route documented. No API verified or needed. An authorized human uses the actual portal and preserves the final acknowledgment; no automated submission is planned.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Commercial signatory approves terms, qualifications and final submission. Finance reviews price assumptions. AI may draft or cross-check, but cannot attest facts, sign, submit, modify bank details or commit capacity without specific human approval.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Confidential commercial and clinician documents restricted by purpose; no student clinical data. Preserve final packet, source/addendum versions and receipts under approved contract-record retention and hold policy.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Versioned folders, checklist, document/PDF editor and a human-operated BidNet account.
capabilities.acceptance: Every mandatory item resolves to evidence or an explicit unresolved gate. A later addendum reopens affected approvals. Only the frozen approved payload is submitted, and an attempted upload without a portal receipt remains submission status UNKNOWN rather than complete.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure register, checklist and packet versioning; excludes legal/commercial review, bid writing, missing business setup and portal access delays.

capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Clarify fee units and required invoice support. Resolve subcontracting/assignment consent before proposing that delivery structure. Bid eligibility, submission and award are not guaranteed.

capabilities.name: Assignments, availability and absence coverage
capabilities.purpose: Schedule only authorized, deliverable in-person work, including indirect duties and travel; keep district approval and backup coverage visible.
minimum_records: Approved workload including therapy, documentation, meetings and travel
Absence, cancellation and backup request history
minimum_states_actions: DRAFT -> RESERVED -> CONFIRMED -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED
HOLD/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW remain distinct
New substitute requires separate readiness, worker acceptance and district approval
Clinical service changes route to district/qualified clinician
capabilities.record_authority: District owns service authorization and student scheduling; agency owns agreed employee work assignments and availability. Calendar entries do not establish delivered service.
capabilities.integration_status: District calendar/assignment platform unknown. Begin with approved order forms and secure confirmations. Calendar synchronization is optional and must exclude unauthorized student data.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Scheduler proposes coverage; district and clinician accept changes. Clinical lead evaluates workload. AI cannot auto-replace a clinician, approve subcontracting, overbook, alter IEP minutes or invent a makeup obligation.
capabilities.privacy_retention: General calendar uses clinician, location and work-block information; student/session detail remains in the district tool unless expressly approved. Access ends with assignment and account revocation is recorded.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Restricted shared calendar plus approved assignment sheet and phone/escalation tree.
capabilities.acceptance: A backup without current district-required clearance cannot be confirmed. The calendar rejects overlapping work/travel blocks. A cancellation remains an unresolved service exception even if compensable work time exists.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure one-buyer availability, work-block templates and coverage procedure; excludes recurring multi-school routing software.

dependencies: ERP03 executed terms and actual order
capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Approve work locations, assignment size, absence reporting, substitution process and any subcontracting before service. Do not infer guaranteed backup availability.

capabilities.name: District clinical-record and service-evidence handoff
capabilities.purpose: Give the qualified therapist approved access to the current service responsibilities and preserve district-owned clinical documentation and required weekly session logs.
actors: Billing reviewer for approved minimum evidence
minimum_records: District system/access reference and training acknowledgment
Exception type and district review owner
minimum_states_actions: ACCESS_PENDING -> DISTRICT_ACCESS_CONFIRMED -> HANDOFF_ACKNOWLEDGED
LOG_DUE -> CLINICIAN_ATTESTED -> DISTRICT_RECEIVED or CORRECTION_REQUESTED
Missed/attempted/delivered service remain distinct; no automatic makeup prescription
capabilities.record_authority: District-designated IEP, clinical and session-log system; therapist signs the clinical record. Agency retains only approved proof/reference of handoff and completion.
capabilities.integration_status: East Ramapo's clinical system and any API are unconfirmed. Do not import Rockland BOCES IEP Direct/Kinney requirements. The initial handoff is manual in district-approved tools; no direct API, bulk export or AI clinical-content access assumed.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: District grants educational-record access; treating SLP makes and attests clinical judgments. The agency follows the district-approved process for attendance/log evidence. AI can remind an owner that a log is due using permitted metadata; clinical drafting is disabled unless separately authorized.
capabilities.privacy_retention: No student notes, IEPs, session recordings or diagnostic content in the general operations/AI workspace. Any allowed student references require documented purpose, recipients, approved processors and category-specific retention. District handles student record access/correction; agency follows approved return/destruction and hold instructions.
capabilities.manual_fallback: District-approved secure records process and a clinician-signed completion/reference checklist without duplicating clinical content.
capabilities.acceptance: A therapist cannot start with unconfirmed plan access. A weekly-log reminder uses approved metadata only. No AI-generated clinical signature or unauthorized student upload is possible. A missing clinical record cannot be fabricated from paid time or a scheduled session.

effort_estimate.basis: Agency handoff/checklist configuration only; district account provisioning, required training and system access timing are outside this estimate.

dependencies: Executed data terms and permitted field/recipient map
capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Identify the actual authoritative system, weekly-log template, access/approval/signature rules, permitted attendance exports and records-return procedure. Complete East Ramapo's applicable DPA/vendor-security process and covered NY Education Law 2-d contractor obligations. Explicitly resolve any AI/subprocessor use before student data is disclosed; neither a vendor listing nor a claim of NYSED certification establishes approval.

capabilities.name: Work time, HR and payroll preparation
capabilities.purpose: Use an established employer/payroll service to pay accurately while keeping actual work separate from district billability and student therapy minutes.
minimum_records: Approved employment model and wage terms
Preparation, meetings, documentation and travel classifications
Human approval, service acknowledgment and payroll result
minimum_states_actions: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> PAY_READY -> EXPORTED
Payroll DRAFT -> AUTHORIZED -> SENT -> RECONCILING -> SETTLED or REJECTED
Corrections preserve prior versions and reasons
capabilities.record_authority: Selected HR/payroll service owns employee tax/bank/payroll records and settlement. Agency timekeeping source owns raw worked time. Operations console retains references and reconciled status.
capabilities.integration_status: No payroll vendor/edition selected or connector tested. Start with approved manual entry/import supported by the selected product. Existing generic ADP API research does not establish a selected implementation.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Employer and qualified payroll owner determine classification and pay treatment. Human authorizes payroll release. Agent may find missing entries or compare totals, but cannot change bank details, suppress worked time because a district disputes payment or release funds.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Bank, tax, identity and payroll access remain restricted in the specialist service. Approved wage/personnel retention schedule, holds and export controls apply; never copy student clinical information into payroll.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Selected payroll provider's manual workflow with reconciled timesheets and signed approval.
capabilities.acceptance: An invoice dispute leaves earned-pay evaluation intact. A paid documentation hour is not counted as delivered therapy. A repeated payroll export is detected and cannot create a duplicate payment. Changed amounts invalidate the prior release approval.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure time categories, approval/checklists and manual reconciliation; excludes employer registration, payroll-provider onboarding and tax/legal advice.

capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Confirm district time/attendance approval requirements separately from the employer's pay obligations.

capabilities.name: District invoicing, receivables and cash-control register
capabilities.purpose: Prepare evidence-backed invoices in the district's required format, submit within the contractual window and track actual collection separately from submission.
minimum_records: Service date and calculated submission deadline
minimum_states_actions: DRAFT -> REVIEW_PENDING -> AUTHORIZED -> ISSUED -> PAID or DISPUTED
District receipt is separate from issuance
Correct/rebill with linked prior version; no silent overwrite
Uncertain submission remains UNKNOWN pending reconciliation
capabilities.record_authority: Executed fee schedule and approved support govern billability; accounting service owns invoices, receivables and cash postings. District owns approval/payment decisions.
capabilities.integration_status: District Accounting/Claims Auditor format is required but current channel, fields and API are unconfirmed. No Medicaid submission route. Manual district-approved submission plus a preserved receipt is the default.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Finance approves each invoice and any credit/write-off. Agent can prepare calculations from approved rules and flag missing support; it cannot invent attendance, reinterpret fee units, issue credits, alter bank instructions or mark an invoice paid without evidence.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Use only district-approved minimum support, transmitted by approved secure means; detailed student clinical notes remain in the district system. Retain accounting and supporting records under approved category schedules and holds.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Accounting software plus a controlled unbilled-service tracker and human-approved secure invoice/support delivery.
capabilities.acceptance: Every service line has a deadline no later than 30 calendar days after service under the reviewed RFP. Internal reminders at 14, 21 and 25 days are proposed controls. A monthly batching rule cannot cause older services to miss the 30-day window. Submission does not become a net-30 payment assumption; receipt, approval and cash collection are separate facts.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure fee/unit register, aging and accounting handoff; excludes accounting provider setup, buyer format clarification and bespoke API development.

capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: Obtain fee units, supporting documents, invoice recipient/channel, Claims Auditor requirements, correction treatment and payment process. No contractual collection period is assumed.

capabilities.name: Operations control room and bounded-agent audit
capabilities.purpose: Make pending decisions, evidence gaps, due dates and agent actions visible to accountable owners; prevent an automation from becoming an unreviewed decision maker.
minimum_records: Case type, severity, owner and due date
Input evidence references and output status
minimum_states_actions: OPEN -> TRIAGED -> IN_REVIEW -> ACTION_PENDING -> RESOLVED -> CLOSED
Draft -> approved exact action -> executed -> reconciled
Revoke agent scope; stop/disable route; preserve evidence
capabilities.record_authority: Agency owns operational cases and immutable or append-only audit evidence; external systems remain authoritative for their business effects.
capabilities.integration_status: No live agent write access enabled. Start with public-document extraction and approved nonsensitive administrative drafting. A spreadsheet/table is acceptable for the pilot only if access, change history, backups and sensitive-data boundaries are actually configured.
capabilities.permissions_and_human_owner: Each action has a named accountable owner. Agents cannot expand their own scopes, approve their own restricted actions, send external messages without delegation, make personnel decisions or release money. Uploaded documents are untrusted evidence, never instructions.
capabilities.privacy_retention: Log references and outcomes without reproducing student records, screening reports, bank details or secrets. Audit retention follows approved categories and holds; model/provider retention and permitted use must be reviewed before personal data processing.
capabilities.manual_fallback: Owned issue register, checklist, approval log and daily operational review; automation outage does not prevent safe staffed operation.
capabilities.acceptance: An injected instruction in a resume cannot change pay, recipients or permissions. A changed rate, attachment or recipient invalidates approval. An outage leaves pending actions visible, and reprocessing produces one verified business effect. Access removal also revokes agent/integration access.

effort_estimate.basis: Configure queues, permissions, manual approval/audit templates and a dry run; excludes a custom agent orchestration platform.

dependencies: Approved data handling and action scopes
capabilities.buyer_acceptance_needed: District approval before any student data reaches a subprocessor/AI system or a tool acts in district systems. No approval is inferred from the existence of a staffing contract.

Prepare correction package and cash forecast inputs

delivery_backlog.deliverable: Operator-owned secure workspace, responsible-owner matrix, clinician and company evidence checklist, bid compliance matrix and draft pricing assumptions.
delivery_backlog.exit_gate: Named clinician and business evidence is either available or explicitly unresolved; critical gaps are visible before any commitment. No student data is collected.
delivery_backlog.effort_position: Four capability setup ranges total 15-30 staff-hours if established tools/accounts are already available; sourcing, insurance and legal work are separate and may dominate elapsed time.

delivery_backlog.window: By October 26 for internal review; published question deadline October 27, noon Eastern; proposal deadline October 30, noon Eastern, subject to subsequent addenda
delivery_backlog.deliverable: Concrete question list, reviewed fee units/rate assumptions, evidence-backed proposal and frozen final packet. Proposed internal final review October 28 and submission target October 29 provide buffer but do not change the district deadline.
delivery_backlog.exit_gate: Authorized signatory confirms truthful capacity, complete mandatory evidence and commercial viability; all current addenda checked. If a critical item remains unresolved, record a no-bid or explicitly permitted qualified response decision rather than inventing compliance.
delivery_backlog.effort_position: Bid writing, legal/insurance review and portal submission are business work, not software implementation. No custom build lies on this deadline.

delivery_backlog.window: After award, executed terms and a real authorized order; start date unconfirmed
delivery_backlog.deliverable: District system/access handoff, cleared lead/backup, workload/calendar, time/payroll workflow, approved invoice template/channel, recurring checks, approved data/retention rules and operational dry run.
delivery_backlog.exit_gate: Credential/coverage/contract/access/employer/cash gates are green; district confirms the provider and assignment; synthetic service-to-pay-to-invoice rehearsal passes with no clinical data.
dependencies: Verified delivery economics and payroll reserve
delivery_backlog.effort_position: Incremental configuration of ERP04-ERP07 is estimated at 15-30 staff-hours, plus hardening/rehearsal below. External onboarding time is not estimated and cannot be compressed by AI.

delivery_backlog.deliverable: Permission checks, source/receipt discipline, offboarding/backup recovery, invoice-age edge cases, agent draft-only controls and owner signoff.
delivery_backlog.exit_gate: Every launch acceptance check has an actual test result and responsible approver. This research document is not the test result.
dependencies: Configured tools and actual approved operating rules
delivery_backlog.effort_position: Allow an additional proposed 8-16 staff-hours for cross-tool permissions, reconciliation and rehearsal. Combined lean configuration planning range: 38-76 staff-hours, excluding subscriptions, bespoke code and all clinical/commercial/employer onboarding.

delivery_backlog.window: After at least one completed service, payroll and invoice/receipt cycle and enough operating evidence to identify recurring friction
delivery_backlog.deliverable: Measure administrative effort, rework, payment behavior and therapist usability; select at most one automation or thin mobile web improvement with a demonstrated benefit.
delivery_backlog.exit_gate: Real baseline and benefit estimate, permitted interface/data use, tested rollback and measurable acceptance. If a manual step takes only minutes for two clinicians, keep it manual.
dependencies: Vendor/district permission and API specification if connecting systems
delivery_backlog.effort_position: Optional 40-80 engineering hours is a preliminary estimate for one narrowly scoped console/mobile workflow or one permitted adapter, not the full operating platform. Re-estimate after interface discovery. Do not include it in bid readiness.
